title: LabVIEW examples export (exampleinfo.json)
description: One entry per VI in lv_src/Examples. Diagram images live in assets/examples/ next to this file; the docs build uses only the file name.

vi name.description: The VI's file name in lv_src/Examples, e.g. "Connect and Disconnect.vi".

diagram image.description: Path of the block diagram image, at native size.

description.description: The VI's description as saved in VI Properties > Documentation.
